additional_selected_retained_original.observed: Same Lounge L-return, green well, wide rectangular steel cap, black glazing frames and adjacent corner. Original remains in source library; no duplicate or source modification.

new_source_findings.fact: Source simultaneously shows StoryWay beside Lounge, the large stainless support on the left branch, glass/transom and circulation-side interface.
Inside-edge view past tripin pier shows the Lounge side glass and green descending well; the edge has a broad silver rectangular cap, not only a thin black gasket.

Joint view includes black Lounge corner frame, the green well head, the continuous silver cap and stainless corridor pier. Head cap is briefly occluded by structural frames/piers; repeated cap portions reappear to either side.

Turn past the stainless pier exposes its full floor contact and the well rail continuing on its other side. This is stronger ordinal/parallax evidence than the former 960px contact views; no pixels or elapsed seconds are used as metres.
Opposite public corridor corner is CafeDeCraft brick/masonry frontage; no new full-height closure or doorway is inferred at the open circulation edge.

lounge_A_B.remaining_identity_limit: The source corridor pier and Lounge support are different roles. The full-floor-contact pier in287.987s has no unique label; its current C10/C11/C12 identity must not be silently assumed to be A-C12 or B-C13. Exact source-to-C176 branch is now the parent-confirmed guard work basis, but that does not automatically identify a Lounge support.

actionable_guard_work.source_to_guard_branch_authority: Parent explicitly identifies current C176 turn(32.4674,30.7905) as this unique source-visible green well. Individual source panel ordinals remain a current-mesh partition, not photo labels.

profile_MODEL.section: Shallow rectangular/U-shaped stainless cap along each actual current guard centreline; keep existing corner angle and meet adjacent caps continuously.
profile_MODEL.dimensions_qualification: Photo-derived MODEL section estimate, not field measurement. Root must fit actual owned top-edge/post geometry; source pixels are not measuring units.
profile_MODEL.corner: Miter/butt construction from the exact current head/return polyline, not an invented90degree corner.
profile_MODEL.dark_seal: Retain a dark recessed seal under/inside the cap channel; no need to erase all existing dark gasket work. Resolve actual owned upper-edge fit locally.
profile_MODEL.steel_material: Reuse current C176_PHOTO_STAINLESS_HAIRLINE.mat for the new cap; preserve source-like silver reflections. No guessed change to all glass/guards.
preserve: Actual post/guard axes and plan perimeter
